mapper.insert: INSERT INTO /* userMapper.insertUser => 회원가입 */ USERS ( LOGIN_ID, USER_KEY, USER_NM, USER_BRTH, ZIP_CD, ADDR, ADDR_DTL, TEL_PHONE, GENDER, PSWD, PSWD_ERR_CNT, EMAIL, NICKNAME, CRET_DT, DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{userKey}, #{userNm}, #{userBrth}, #{zipCd}, #{addr}, #{addrDtl}, #{telPhone}, #{gender}, #{encPswd}, 0, #{email}, #{nickname}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT /* userMapper.selectUserInfo => 사용자 정보 조회 */ USER_KEY, PSWD, LOGIN_ID, USER_NM, NICKNAME, EMAIL FROM USERS WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT * /* userMapper.selectLoginId => 아이디 중복 체크 */ FROM USERS WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT * /* userMapper.selectEmail => 이메일 중복 체크 */ FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
